item.title: sshole
item.dc:creator: josemrb
item.description:
OpenSSH on musl Linux has reportedly allowed access to passwordless accounts since 2016. The issue relates to how Unix historically represented accounts that should never permit login, including accounts marked with an asterisk in the password file. The behavior can therefore expose accounts that were intended to be inaccessible.

据报道，musl Linux 上的 OpenSSH 自 2016 年起可能允许进入无密码账户。问题与 Unix 处理本应禁止登录的账户的历史方式有关，包括在密码文件中用星号标记的账户。因此，原本应不可访问的账户可能被暴露。

item.description:

item.title: Declarative Dragging
item.dc:creator: smusamashah
item.description:
Declarative dragging proposes that interface authors define which future model states an element may reach by dragging. This makes a diagram element draggable by describing its allowed outcomes rather than implementing dragging behavior directly. The work was named the Best Paper at UIST 2026.

“声明式拖拽”提出，界面作者可以通过指定元素拖动后允许到达的模型状态来定义拖拽行为。这样，创建可拖动的图表元素不必直接实现拖拽逻辑，而是描述其允许的结果。该研究获得了 UIST 2026 最佳论文奖。
